content: WS backpressure for fan-out (detailed eng article + matches coder bug): never await ws.send in the broadcast loop (slowest client stalls all) and never spawn unbounded send tasks (OOM); per-client bounded queue + single dedicated writer task per conn (only writer touches socket); producer uses try_send/put_nowait, QueueFull = precise lag signal; drop policy depends on data semantics - terminal output is an ORDERED DELTA stream so dropping frames silently corrupts client state => disconnect slow client with close 1013 + resync on reconnect (ring buffer replay is the resync mechanism) or drop+force-resync; 80% high-watermark early warning + strikes counter that RESETS on success; export per-client queue depth as metrics not logs; memory bound = maxbacklog*framesize*clients computable upfront.
